CQuotient.initFromCookies = function () {
	var ca = document.cookie.split(';');
	for(var i=0;i < ca.length;i++) {
	  var c = ca[i];
	  while (c.charAt(0)==' ') c = c.substring(1,c.length);

		CQuotient.cqcid=c.substring('cqcid='.length,c.length);

      OPENED: 'opened',
      CLOSED: 'closed'
    };
    const WIDGET_ACTION = {
      OPEN: 'open',
      CLOSE: 'close',
      OPEN_LABEL: 'Abrir janela de Chat',
      CLOSE_LABEL: 'Fechar janela de Chat'
    };

    const widgetButton = document.createElement('button');
    widgetButton.className = 'custom-widget-launcher';
    widgetButton.setAttribute('data-state', WIDGET_STATE.CLOSED);
    widgetButton.setAttribute('aria-label', WIDGET_ACTION.OPEN_LABEL);
    widgetButton.setAttribute('title', WIDGET_ACTION.OPEN_LABEL);
    document.body.appendChild(widgetButton);

    widgetButton.insertAdjacentHTML('afterBegin', `

    `);

    widgetButton.addEventListener('click', () => {
      if (widgetButton.dataset.state === WIDGET_STATE.OPENED) {
        zE('messenger', WIDGET_ACTION.CLOSE);
        return;
      }
      if (widgetButton.dataset.state === WIDGET_STATE.CLOSED) {
        zE('messenger', WIDGET_ACTION.OPEN);
        return;
      }
    });

    zE("messenger:on", WIDGET_ACTION.OPEN, function () {
      widgetButton.setAttribute('data-state', WIDGET_STATE.OPENED);
      widgetButton.setAttribute('aria-label', WIDGET_ACTION.CLOSE_LABEL);
      widgetButton.setAttribute('title', WIDGET_ACTION.CLOSE_LABEL);
    });

    zE("messenger:on", WIDGET_ACTION.CLOSE, function () {
      widgetButton.setAttribute('data-state', WIDGET_STATE.CLOSED);
      widgetButton.setAttribute('aria-label', WIDGET_ACTION.OPEN_LABEL);
      widgetButton.setAttribute('title', WIDGET_ACTION.OPEN_LABEL);
    });

    zE("messenger:on", "unreadMessages", function (count) {
      if (count === 0) {
        widgetButton.removeAttribute('data-unread');
        return;
      }
      widgetButton.setAttribute('data-unread', count);
    });
  });
